description:
What is This Part?
This is the Transmission Clutch Cable for the Transmission to the Clutch Pedal.
Cable is 62″
Fits RHD (Right hand drive) Models
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Clutch Cable
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 RHD
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 RHD
